hook: The DFT is just samples of the DTFT.

beats.say: Eli Bendersky's new post tackles realistic signal processing, where signals are both discrete and finite.
The trick: treat your N samples as one period of a periodic signal, so the discrete-time Fourier series reconstructs them exactly.
Scale those coefficients and you get the DFT, which turns out to be equally spaced samples of the continuous DTFT, with Python code to compute it.
